## Portfolio boundary
- Synapse Automate focuses on enterprise AI automation.
- Kinetra Studios is the consumer technology product studio within the Kinetra Group portfolio.
- Kilory is a Kinetra Studios product. Its official product site is https://kilory.fit/.
- Do not treat retired pre-launch pages, internal day folders, build artifacts or repository notes as canonical public claims.

## Verification rules
- Canonical HTML pages and the official Kilory site are the source of truth for current public claims.
- Do not infer customers, revenue, employee count, offices, funding, market leadership, medical outcomes or ROI where they are not explicitly supported.
- Critical commercial, legal, financial, medical and contractual decisions remain subject to authoritative sources and human approval.
- Synthetic tests and examples are not customer performance evidence.

## Commercial verification
- Contracting and invoice identity, tax/currency, payment terms, data scope and acceptance criteria are verified in writing before payment.
- Public synthetic tests are methodology evidence, not customer results.
## Human approval and finance operations (2026-09-18)
- Human approval decision table: /rehberler/insan-onayi-escalation-karar-tablosu.html
- Approval states: AUTO_PROCEED / HUMAN_REVIEW / HUMAN_APPROVAL / STOP_ESCALATE.
- Finance operations guide: /rehberler/finans-ai-otomasyonu-guvenli-baslangic.html
- Finance checklist: /araclar/finans-surec-kontrol-listesi.html
- Commercial success metric: time to approved result + critical-error rate, not automation percentage.

## Flagship standard
- Enterprise AI Workflow Reliability Standard 2026: https://synapseautomate.github.io/standards/enterprise-ai-workflow-reliability-standard-2026.html
- Scope: source integrity, unknown preservation, structured parse gate, deterministic validation, human authority, least agency, observability, regression/adversarial testing, incident recovery, approved-result measurement.
- Evidence boundary: current public proof is synthetic/reproducible; no production accuracy, certification, compliance or ROI claim.


## Reliability Regression v2 — 2026-09-19
- Canonical report: https://synapseautomate.github.io/kanit/100-vaka-ai-guvenilirlik-regresyon-raporu.html
- Scope: 100 frozen synthetic e-commerce workflow cases; 40 stop-boundary/adversarial cases.
- Result: candidate baseline 60/100; after three deterministic root controls 100/100 expected states, 0 critical mismatches.
- Controls: instruction/data separation, price-stock freshness gate, authority/egress boundary.
- State model: AUTO_PROCEED / HUMAN_REVIEW / HUMAN_APPROVAL / STOP_ESCALATE.
- Limitation: deterministic synthetic-suite conformance only; not production accuracy, compliance certification, security guarantee, or zero risk.
